cases.synopsis: Owner-authorized route after R2 construct underdetermination: reopen the relevant design space without preservation bias, preserve R2/history/authority evidence, use progressive development before confirmation, keep hidden R2 item semantics sealed, and hold dependent progression until successor reconciliation.
ledger: The objective is the strongest coherent Project system, not minimum change from existing architecture.
Research 436 owns the progressive-development and development-vs-confirmation scientific process.
R2 may not be retried, relabeled, threshold-tuned, converted to a final key, or rescued by owner adjudication.
Historical LEGACY remains INCONCLUSIVE/EXCLUDED and P6C remains NOT_RUN as current result state derived from the frozen R2 record.
Specification 028 remains current operational/migration authority until prospectively changed.
This successor-research route does not authorize physical migration or an authority switch.
No current DRP-03 mechanism has preservation rights merely because it exists or was expensive.
Truthful R1/R2 history, provenance, maturity distinctions and development/confirmation separation are process requirements owned by research governance.
Hidden R2 item-level semantic material remains sealed during initial redesign.
Any future hidden-R2 exposure proposal must first document why exposure is needed, burned evidence, retired concealment boundaries, and replacement confirmatory evidence.
Successor stages S1-S7 define the current development/reconciliation program and its dependent-program return path.
Scaling to a larger experiment requires a stated new property/uncertainty/integration reason; size alone is not justification.
Every development probe records its question, candidate version, evidence role, change permissions, burn status and abandonment condition before execution.
Dependent DRP progression remains gated until successor semantics are sufficiently qualified or the dependency is explicitly removed by architecture change.
Preservation-bias or retry-to-green patterns are useful control observations but do not themselves create authority.

clauses.meaning: Authorize DRP-03 successor design/development work under the Research 436 route only.
Prohibit any operation that treats frozen R2 as rerunnable/rescorable/relabelable/rescuable or creates an R2 final key.
Hidden R2 item-level semantic exposure requires a separate prospective owner route satisfying the Research 436 exposure contract.
Physical migration or operational authority switch requires separately governed authority; the Research 436 successor route is insufficient.
Dependent DRP progression requires successor semantic qualification/reconciliation or an explicit architecture change removing the dependency.

human_governing_only: optimize for strongest coherent system rather than minimum change
ambiguities: Production semantic reference syntax for predicate/action/scope refs is not frozen; SP-2 uses development-stable symbolic refs only.

cases.synopsis: Reconciliation that makes OPERATIVE V0.1 the leading development candidate while retiring key inferred-ontology assumptions, introducing J1/J2/J3 ownership timing, preserving owner review and human-governing meaning, requiring executable deterministic semantics, and freezing the SP development route and null baseline.
ledger: Research 438 prospectively amends Research 437 for the affected successor-design scope.
OPERATIVE becomes leading development candidate but is not a selected production target.
J1 governing meaning, J2 realization coverage and J3 operational truth allocation is owned by the architecture-development contract.
G/H/I/J/K/N candidate-mechanism statuses and family dispositions are architecture-development state.
Owner-faithfulness, grammar validity, deterministic behavior, leak detection, CQ sufficiency and adoption cost replace fresh-author agreement as authored-semantics development criteria.
Machine-operative meaning is deliberately narrower than all human-governing meaning; non-operative human authority is not erased.
Machine-operative authoring requires an explicit proposal/acceptance boundary and review legitimacy.
Expressiveness limits and clause lifecycle are development questions owned by the successor architecture program.
Any deterministic consequential derived decision/predicate claimed by the Project system must have an executable normative definition and regression tests.
DRP-01 shared primitive specialization cannot silently rename/rewrite the passed seam and requires requalification.

Family A, birth-time grouping, inferred exclusive normative kind, generic materiality boolean, global realization-state enum and fresh-author validity for authored meaning are retired from the active successor route.
Human-readable governing meaning and machine-operative clauses belong to one accepted meaning boundary; generated projections do not gain separate semantic authority.
SP-0 through SP-6 sequence, corpus discipline and development-burn rules are owned by the development-probe program.
Hidden R2 remains sealed by the already-governing Research 436/435 boundary rather than being re-authored here.
A seeded-error SP-5 owner-review efficacy run requires explicit informed owner authorization before execution.
Any adoption-economics claim for structured normative machinery must compare with the detective-only null baseline N.
LLM-produced semantic drafts/diagnostics are non-authoritative until admitted through the proper governing or natural-owner path.
The architecture should not redefine human authority merely because a meaning is deliberately non-operative.
Dependent DRPs remain held and their successor dependencies are remapped only after later OPERATIVE development stages.

clauses.meaning: Amend Research 437 by Research 438 for the reconciled successor-design scope.
One governed acceptance boundary must bind human-governing meaning and admitted machine-operative semantics; generated projections are not independent authority.
Deterministic consequential Project-system predicates/decisions must be defined executably and regression-tested.
SP-5 seeded-error owner-review efficacy execution requires explicit informed owner authorization.
An adoption-economics claim for structured normative machinery requires the detective-only null baseline N.
Model/LLM semantic output may not become governing machine authority merely because it was generated.

human_governing_only: human authority may exceed deliberately machine-operative meaning
ambiguities: The exact accepted-object physical representation and production clause-reference type remain intentionally open.

cases.synopsis: Exact V0.2 candidate: thin typed governing clauses plus exact domain-native contract references form one acceptance boundary; accepted semantics compile with current authoritative facts into disposable non-authoritative control projections; realization moves to natural owners; deterministic truth is executable; model inference remains advisory until accepted.
ledger: V0.2 intentionally chooses a thin governing-semantics architecture rather than a universal requirements database.
One governed acceptance object may bind multiple exact physical components/revisions as one meaning boundary.
Generated JSON/index/database/control projections do not gain independent semantic authority.
Accepted-component inconsistency causes validation failure or later defect/evolution handling; future LLM guesswork is not a resolver.
The five-condition thin-clause admission algorithm belongs to the OPERATIVE grammar/admission contract.
The seven candidate clause forms and their slot schemas belong to the OPERATIVE grammar contract.
INVARIANT/ASSIGN/ROUTE are deliberately absent as standalone forms unless later competency evidence justifies them.
Machine-critical deterministic behavior must bind bounded typed references, not later interpretation of free text.
When one domain already owns exact machine semantics, generic operative clauses reference that domain contract rather than duplicate it.
Compiler/projection implementation owns versioning, exact-input binding, staleness invalidation, conflict fail-visible behavior and rebuildability.
ActionContract, ControlObligationSet, gate inputs and coverage expectations are disposable projections compiled from authority + current facts.
J2 realization coverage is declared by natural realizing owners; no canonical birth-time grouping is inferred.
J3 operational truth is computed from source-owned facts through executable predicates; no global authored realization-state truth.
Unaccepted model inference cannot become governing authority, choose normative owner decisions, override deterministic policy, or resolve authority conflict by confidence.
Models/classifiers may nominate event hypotheses, leaks, legacy candidates, coverage suggestions and explanations subject to later policy.
The near-zero authoring-cost hypothesis is withdrawn; only a weaker affordability hypothesis remains.
V0.2 falsifiers F1-F8 govern development learning but are not confirmatory thresholds.
SP-2 review/reconciliation must occur before SP-3 is frozen against a surviving exact grammar.

clauses.meaning: A governing acceptance binds human carrier, operative component and referenced domain-contract revisions as one accepted meaning boundary.
Generated projections/indexes/compiled ActionContracts may not be treated as independent semantic authority.
Machine-critical deterministic clause semantics use bounded typed references; unresolved free-text dependence routes to review/human governance instead of hidden inference.
When a domain-native accepted contract fully owns a detail, cross-domain OPERATIVE semantics reference that contract rather than restating its machine meaning.
Unaccepted model inference may not create governing authority, silently decide normative owner choices, override deterministic policy, or settle authority conflict by confidence.
SP-2 must complete and V0.2 must survive/reconcile before SP-3 protocol freeze.

human_governing_only: affordability hypothesis and broader design rationale
ambiguities: A production canonical type system for action/consequence/predicate/scope references does not yet exist; this is intentionally deferred development work rather than filled with free text.

owner_review.instruction: Judge whether each proposed routing + clause set faithfully preserves the intended governing meaning for this development purpose. Corrections are welcome. Do not infer that ACCEPT selects OPERATIVE for production.
